network traffic in firewall policy rules. Each net-service can

ArubaNetService_AlgDns.description:
Grouping for DNS ALG configuration. Defines DNS packet inspection
and filtering options for Distributed Services Switches (DSS).

dns-alg.description:
Domain Name System (DNS) ALG configuration for Distributed
Services Switches (DSS). Enables inspection of DNS packets
with options to drop anomalous packets and limit message size.

drop-large-domain-name-packets.description:
When set to true, drops DNS packets where any label length
is 64 bytes or higher, exceeding the DNS specification limit.
Default: false.

drop-long-label-packets.description:
When set to true, drops DNS packets where the total domain
name size exceeds 255 bytes. Default: false.

drop-multi-question-packets.description:
When set to true, drops DNS packets that contain more than
one question in the query section. This helps prevent
certain DNS-based attacks. Default: false.

max-message-length.description:
Maximum allowed DNS message length in bytes. Messages
exceeding this length are dropped. Valid range: 1-8129.
Default: 512 bytes.

ArubaNetService_AlgFtp.description:
Grouping for FTP ALG configuration. Defines FTP packet inspection
options for Distributed Services Switches (DSS).

ftp-alg.description:
File Transfer Protocol (FTP) ALG configuration for Distributed
Services Switches (DSS). Enables inspection of FTP control
connections to correctly handle dynamic data port negotiation.
The net-service protocol must be TCP (protocol 6 or IP_TCP).

allow-mismatch-ip-address.description:
When set to true, allows FTP data connections where the IP
address in the FTP PORT/PASV command payload differs from
the IP header source address. This is useful in NAT
environments. Default: false.

ArubaNetService_AlgIcmp.description:
Grouping for ICMP ALG configuration. Defines ICMP type and code
filters for Distributed Services Switches (DSS).

icmp-alg.description:
Internet Control Message Protocol (ICMP) ALG configuration
for Distributed Services Switches (DSS). Allows filtering
ICMP traffic by specific message type and code.

code.description:
ICMP code that provides additional detail for the specified
ICMP type. This is a required field. For example, for type 3
(Destination Unreachable), code 0 means Network Unreachable
and code 1 means Host Unreachable. Valid range: 0-18.

type.description:
ICMP message type number. This is a required field. Common
values include 0 (Echo Reply), 3 (Destination Unreachable),
8 (Echo Request), and 11 (Time Exceeded). Valid range: 0-255.

ArubaNetService_AlgMsrpc.description:
Grouping for Microsoft RPC ALG configuration. Defines MSRPC program
UUIDs and timeout for Distributed Services Switches (DSS).

msrpc-alg.description:
Microsoft Remote Procedure Call (MSRPC) ALG configuration for
Distributed Services Switches (DSS). Enables inspection of
MSRPC endpoint mapper traffic to correctly handle dynamic
port assignments. The net-service protocol must be TCP or UDP
and the port must be 135 (endpoint mapper).

program-uuids.description:
List of MSRPC program UUIDs to inspect. Each UUID identifies
a specific MSRPC service interface.

items.description:
List of MSRPC program UUIDs to inspect. Each UUID identifies
a specific MSRPC service interface.
items.x-typeDescription:
A Universally Unique IDentifier in the string representation
defined in RFC 4122.  The canonical representation uses
lowercase characters.

The following is an example of a UUID in string representation:
f81d4fae-7dec-11d0-a765-00a0c91e6bf6

timeout.description:
Timeout in seconds for tracking MSRPC endpoint bindings.
After this period, dynamically learned port mappings are
removed. Default: 60 seconds.

ArubaNetService_NetServicesSchemaGET.description:
Configuration container for network services. Net-services define
protocol and port combinations used to identify specific types of
network traffic in firewall policy rules. Each net-service can
specify a protocol (TCP, UDP, etc.), individual ports or port
ranges, and optional ALG processing for application-aware
traffic handling.

net-service.description:
List of network service definitions. Each net-service defines
a named protocol/port combination that can be referenced in
policy rules to match specific types of network traffic. The
key 'name' uniquely identifies the net-service.

alg-config.description:
Application Layer Gateway (ALG) configuration for Distributed
Services Switches (DSS). This container is only available when
alg-service is set to ICMP, DNS, FTP, MSRPC, or SUNRPC. Each
ALG type exposes its own sub-container with protocol-specific
configuration options.

alg-service.description:
Specifies the Application Layer Gateway (ALG) service type
for this net-service. ALG enables deep packet inspection
for application-specific protocols, allowing the firewall
to handle dynamic port negotiation and NAT traversal. The
selected ALG must be compatible with the configured protocol
(TCP, UDP, or other). See the must constraint for valid
protocol/ALG combinations.

x-enumDescriptions.DHCP:
Enables ALG for DHCP traffic allowing dynamic relay and
inspection of DHCP messages. Requires UDP protocol.
x-enumDescriptions.DNS:
Enables ALG for DNS traffic allowing inspection and optional
filtering of DNS queries and responses. Requires UDP protocol.
Additional DNS ALG options can be configured via the alg-config
container when this value is selected.
x-enumDescriptions.FACETIME:
Enables ALG for Apple FaceTime video calling traffic.
Requires TCP protocol.
x-enumDescriptions.FTP:
Enables ALG for FTP traffic allowing inspection and NAT
traversal of FTP control and data connections. Requires TCP
protocol. Additional FTP ALG options can be configured via
the alg-config container when this value is selected.
x-enumDescriptions.H323:
Enables ALG for H.323 video conferencing and VoIP
signaling traffic. Requires TCP or UDP protocol.
x-enumDescriptions.ICMP:
Enables ALG for ICMP traffic allowing inspection by type
and code. Additional ICMP ALG options can be configured via
the alg-config container when this value is selected.
x-enumDescriptions.JABBER:
Enables ALG for Cisco Jabber unified communications traffic.
Requires TCP or UDP protocol.
x-enumDescriptions.MSRPC:
Enables ALG for Microsoft RPC (Remote Procedure Call) traffic.
Requires TCP or UDP protocol on port 135. Additional MSRPC
ALG options can be configured via the alg-config container.
x-enumDescriptions.NOE:
Enables ALG for Alcatel NOE (New Office Environment) VoIP
traffic. Requires UDP protocol.
x-enumDescriptions.RTSP:
Enables ALG for RTSP (Real Time Streaming Protocol) media
streaming traffic. Requires TCP or UDP protocol.
x-enumDescriptions.SCCP:
Enables ALG for SCCP (Skinny Client Control Protocol) used
by Cisco IP phones. Requires TCP protocol.
x-enumDescriptions.SIP:
Enables ALG for SIP (Session Initiation Protocol) VoIP
signaling traffic. Requires TCP or UDP protocol.
x-enumDescriptions.SIPS:
Enables ALG for SIPS (SIP over TLS) encrypted VoIP
signaling traffic. Requires TCP protocol.
x-enumDescriptions.SUNRPC:
Enables ALG for SUN RPC (Remote Procedure Call) traffic.
Requires TCP or UDP protocol on port 111. Additional SUNRPC
ALG options can be configured via the alg-config container.
x-enumDescriptions.SVP:
Enables ALG for SVP (SpectraLink Voice Priority) wireless
VoIP traffic. Requires a protocol other than TCP or UDP.
x-enumDescriptions.TFTP:
Enables ALG for TFTP (Trivial File Transfer Protocol)
traffic. Requires UDP protocol.
x-enumDescriptions.VOCERA:
Enables ALG for Vocera badge communication traffic.
Requires UDP protocol.

alg-service.x-typeDescription:
Application Layer Gateway (ALG) service types. Each ALG type
enables deep packet inspection for a specific application protocol,
allowing the firewall to understand and correctly handle protocol-specific
behavior such as dynamic port negotiation and NAT traversal.

description.description:
An optional human-readable description for this net-service.
Can be used to document the purpose or intended use.
Maximum length is 128 characters.

http-proxy.description:
When set to true, marks this net-service port as an HTTP
proxy port for web traffic interception. Only applicable
when no ALG service is configured. Default: false.

https-proxy.description:
When set to true, marks this net-service port as an HTTPS
proxy port for secure web traffic interception. Only
applicable when no ALG service is configured. Default: false.

name.description:
Unique name of the net-service. This is a required key field.
Maximum length is 63 characters.

port-range.description:
Port range specification for this net-service. If operator
is COMPARISON_RANGE, both min and max values define the range.
If operator is COMPARISON_EQ, only the min value is used as
the exact port match. Cannot be used together with the ports
leaf-list.

max.description:
Upper bound of port range. Only applicable when operator
is COMPARISON_RANGE. Must be greater than min. Protocol
must be TCP or UDP.
max.x-typeDescription:
A 16-bit port number used by a transport protocol such as TCP
or UDP.

min.description:
Port value or lower bound of port range. When operator
is COMPARISON_EQ, this is the exact port to match. When
operator is COMPARISON_RANGE, this is the lower bound.
Protocol must be TCP or UDP.
min.x-typeDescription:
A 16-bit port number used by a transport protocol such as TCP
or UDP.

operator.description:
Comparison operator for port matching. When set to
COMPARISON_EQ, matches a single port (min). When set
to COMPARISON_RANGE, matches all ports between min
and max inclusive. Protocol must be TCP or UDP.

x-enumDescriptions.COMPARISON_RANGE: Minimum and maximum values of range.

ports.description:
List of individual port numbers for this net-service. Cannot
be used together with port-range. The protocol must be TCP
or UDP when ports are specified.

items.description:
List of individual port numbers for this net-service. Cannot
be used together with port-range. The protocol must be TCP
or UDP when ports are specified.
items.x-typeDescription:
A 16-bit port number used by a transport protocol such as TCP
or UDP.

protocol.description:
Specifies the IP protocol for this net-service, expressed
either as an IP protocol number or a named identity (e.g.,
IP_TCP for 6, IP_UDP for 17). This determines which transport
protocol the service matches. Must not be set when alg-service
is ICMP.

be used together with port-range. The protocol must be TCP
or UDP when ports are specified.

items.description:
List of individual port numbers for this net-service. Cannot
be used together with port-range. The protocol must be TCP
or UDP when ports are specified.
items.x-typeDescription:
A 16-bit port number used by a transport protocol such as TCP
or UDP.

protocol.description:
Specifies the IP protocol for this net-service, expressed
either as an IP protocol number or a named identity (e.g.,
IP_TCP for 6, IP_UDP for 17). This determines which transport
protocol the service matches. Must not be set when alg-service
is ICMP.

delete_device_function.description: Device function for which the local object needs to be deleted. Mandatory if object_type = LOCAL. Should not be provided for object_type = SHARED.
delete_device_function.name: device-function

delete_object_type.description: LOCAL - To delete local objects. SHARED - To delete shared objects. Default - Defaults to SHARED if not provided
delete_object_type.name: object-type

delete_scope_id.description: Scope at which local object needs to be deleted. Mandatory if object-type = LOCAL. Should not be provided for object-type = SHARED.
delete_scope_id.name: scope-id

detailed.description: True - Includes annotations in the returned json to indicate the type of object, scope, and device function. False - Returns only config objects without annotations.
detailed.name: detailed

effective.description: True - Returns effective configuration (i.e hierarchically merged configuration). False - Returns committed configuration at a given scope.
effective.name: effective

get_device_function.description: Filters configuration specific to given device-function type. If not provided and view_type = LOCAL, then defaults to all device-function's.
get_device_function.name: device-function

get_object_type.description: Retrieves LOCAL or SHARED or both(default) configuration objects.
get_object_type.name: object-type

get_scope_id.description: Configuration at a given scope. Mandatory for view-type = LOCAL.
get_scope_id.name: scope-id

patch_device_function.description: Device function for which the local object needs to be updated. Mandatory if object_type = LOCAL. Should not be provided for object_type = SHARED.
patch_device_function.name: device-function

patch_object_type.description: LOCAL - To update local objects. SHARED - To update shared objects. Default - Defaults to SHARED if not provided
patch_object_type.name: object-type

patch_scope_id.description: Scope at which local object needs to be updated. Mandatory if object-type = LOCAL. Should not be provided for object-type = SHARED.
patch_scope_id.name: scope-id

post_device_function.description: Device function for which the local object needs to be created. Mandatory if object_type = LOCAL. Should not be provided for object_type = SHARED.
post_device_function.name: device-function

post_object_type.description: LOCAL - To create local objects. SHARED - To create shared objects. Default - Defaults to SHARED if not provided
post_object_type.name: object-type

post_scope_id.description: Scope at which local object needs to be created. Mandatory if object-type = LOCAL. Should not be provided for object-type = SHARED.
post_scope_id.name: scope-id

view_type.description: LIBRARY - Returns shared objects in library. For LIBRARY, all other parameters listed below, except 'detailed' , will be ignored. LOCAL - Returns configurations for a scope and one or more device function based on parameters below.
view_type.name: view-type
